Resolved on 2026-10-28 by G1 (section 17.7): run-level rows_examined counts only distinct data rows of declared inputs read by an executed check, so the pin comparison of summary_consistency no longer counts, rows_examined is 0, and the PASS contract's zero-rows finding fires (report.md: 'rows_examined=0').
Only a header-only CSV is covered. Empty JSON inputs, filters that exclude every row, and checks whose scope is empty for other reasons are not exercised.
